reads.sell: Argentina's own white grape, grown high in the Andes: rose petal, jasmine and peach on the nose, yet dry and fresh on the palate. Try it with empanadas, ceviche or anything with a little chilli heat.

why.grape: A perfume of rose, jasmine and orange blossom that promises sweetness, then a dry palate with fresh acid and a faintly bitter, phenolic finish: the Torrontés trick.
why.climate: Fully ripe peach and floral fruit with alcohol reaching medium plus say strong sun and warmth, while cold nights at altitude hold the acidity at medium plus or above.
